doc: PRD §8.5 and D43, a Member who signs up on 4 September, read that day with no Spends: the window is max(1 September, 4 September) = 4 September to today, 1 elapsed day, so Home reads "Streak day 1", not "Streak day 4" (acceptance 11, SCREEN-STATES A8); Money In £0 with Payday 25 still 21 days ahead (§8.2), target £2,400 × 20 ÷ 100 = £480 (§8.4), days remaining 30 − 4 + 1 = 27 (§8.7); not partial, the 25th is still ahead (§8.11).

savingTarget.progressSentence: Nothing to keep yet. Your salary lands on the 25th.
